name: test_known_issue_ids_are_unique_and_kinds_are_registered
description:
Objective: Known-issue IDs are unique and every entry has a registered kind, summary, tests and environment.
Preconditions: Repository dependencies are installed; execute in the deterministic lane with no deployed-service or customer-data dependency.
Steps:
1. Run the case in the repository deterministic lane with the deployed browser/service fixtures disabled.
2. Import tests.support.known_issues and inspect every KnownIssue.
Expected: 1. IDs are unique; kinds are within KINDS; each entry has tests, a summary and only qa/staging/prod environments.
